text:
rachel_marketing: Working on a one-pager for regulated buyers post-webinar. Goal: single-sheet for AE, 3 short ad variants, and simple inbound routing rules.

devin_growth: For ads let's try two CTAs first week: 'Book a compliance review' and 'See SLA pricing'. Split 50/50.

mike_sales: Handoff needs: one-pager PDF, 3-line AE intro, 3 rebuttals, pricing band. Any lead with tags (gov|health|finserv) -> enterprise queue.

zoe_prod: Benchmarks to include (anonymized): "pilot: 6k context, reserved private pool p99 ~115ms; hosted pool p99 ~180-250ms." Also note caching savings ~30%.

ariya_ops: Routing rule proposal: keyword match (gov, HIPAA, PCI, KMS) -> queue enterprise-sdr; ARR_est > 100k -> assign AE. Webhook example below.

rachel_marketing: Micro-copy variants (headline - subhead):
1) Compliance-first - "Keep keys. Keep control." - "Private Pods + HSM and auditable logs for regulated teams."
2) Performance-first - "Consistent sub-150ms p99 for long context." - "Dedicated pools tuned for low-latency inference."
3) Cost-first - "Predictable spend for mission-critical apps." - "Reserved capacity and caching trim token costs."

ariya_ops: Webhook snippet (internal):
POST https://hooks.redwood/internal-leads
Authorization: Bearer <token>
{ "company": "<company>", "email": "<email>", "tags": ["<tags>"], "estimated_arr": "<num>", "source": "webinar|ad" }

mike_sales: Legal-safe SLA copy needed: specify contractual SLAs apply to Dedicated/Private only; hosted is best-effort.

tom_legal: Confirmed. Use 'target latency' for hosted messaging and reserve contractual terms for committed contracts.

rachel_marketing: Timeline: draft one-pager today, legal sign-off tomorrow AM, paid A/B launch Thu. I'll upload PDF when ready. Any blockers?
